name: Shimoyama Kouta
source:
A young boy who adores his older sister; unaware that she harbors sexual designs on him,
he dutifully obeys her—even when she scolds or teases him.
Although he remained devoted to her even after she took his virginity and turned him into a sex slave, he plunged into the depths of despair after being handed over to her friend to be used as a toy—all while witnessing the look of ecstasy on his sister's face as she watched.

Typically wears a school uniform and shorts. Small-sized penis with phimosis (forced to expose the glans by his sister).
